# Requirements Quality Checklist: Practice feedback

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate for audio, history ownership, responsive UX and local speech requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by executing the installed speckit-checklist instructions with explicit detailed PR-review focus.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer owns markers; generation leaves unchecked. PM may toggle only following explicit reviewer approval delegated to PM with final-file evidence.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` approves requirement quality, never implementation completeness.

## Completeness and clarity

- [x] CHK001 Are all F01–F08 outcomes traced to stories and priorities? [Completeness, classification F01–F08]
- [x] CHK002 Is solo replay independent from reference/audio highlight and microphone capture? [Clarity, Spec FR001/US1]
- [x] CHK003 Are comparison defaults, offsets, durations, stop and failure semantics defined? [Completeness, Spec FR002–004; Contracts Media]
- [x] CHK004 Are capture permission, mic-only input, previous-take preservation and endpointing fallback specified? [Coverage, Spec US1/FR003–004]
- [x] CHK005 Is isolated-word quality defined individually with contextual/linking distinction and fallback? [Measurability, Spec FR005–006/SC003]
- [x] CHK006 Is history completion vs playback start/partial/word/take and playlist Completed unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec US4/FR007]

## Persistence and security

- [x] CHK007 Are account ownership, idempotency, concurrent tabs and duplicate conflict requirements specified? [Coverage, Spec FR007/013; Data history]
- [x] CHK008 Are logout, offline, retry limits, unsaved loss-on-exit and identity-change recovery stated? [Edge Case, Spec US4; Contracts History]
- [x] CHK009 Are data fields, grants/RLS, private content and deletion bounds explicit without persisted take/text? [Consistency, Spec FR013; Data model]
- [x] CHK010 Are cloud ASR exclusion, local capability proof, model download and no-text fallback consistent with owner choice? [Consistency, Spec US6/FR011/013]
- [x] CHK011 Are transcript privacy boundaries including feedback screenshot/context specified? [Completeness, Contracts Local transcript]

## Interaction and quality

- [x] CHK012 Are available desktop height, list-only scroll and short/mobile/zoom accessibility fallback scoped? [Clarity, Spec FR008/SC005; Contracts Layout]
- [x] CHK013 Are collapse focus, restore and account/Privacy/Playlists access specified? [Coverage, Spec FR009]
- [x] CHK014 Are cue opt-in/mute, visual redundancy, suppression and failures defined? [Coverage, Spec FR010/SC006]
- [x] CHK015 Are synchronization tolerances measured against expected offset and actual device output rather than call times? [Measurability, Spec SC002; Quickstart device]
- [x] CHK016 Are fixture evidence vs independent listener/device evidence explicitly distinguished? [Clarity, Spec FR014; Quickstart]

## Scope and delivery

- [x] CHK017 Are superseded overlap/persistence contracts identified without adding video import/pronunciation scoring? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions; Plan Summary]
- [x] CHK018 Are paid generation/publication and optional schema gated separately from safe delivery? [Dependencies, Spec FR015; Plan phases]
- [x] CHK019 Are parallel ownership, shared-file integration and reviewer probes concrete? [Completeness, execution.md]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements→tasks→checks traceable and all implementation checkboxes initially empty? [Completeness, tasks.md; pm-review.md]

## Notes

Review recorded separately in pm-review.md with hashes. speckit-implement reads checklist state but never changes markers. Built-in requirements.md is maintained by Specify/Clarify independently.
